Resist the temptation to choose baked potatoes smothered with high-
fat toppings. Your best bet is to order an additional plain potato and
split the broccoli and cheese topping (14 g of fat) between the two.
That way, you end up with a hearty 800-calorie, high-carbohydrate
meal, with only 15 percent of the calories from fat. For additional
protein, drink low-fat milk.
© Order pizza with thick crust rather than extra cheese. More dough
means more muscle fuel. A slice of Domino's thick-crust pizza has 9
more grams of carbohydrate than a slice of the thin-crust pizza. Pile
on vegetables (green peppers, mushrooms, onions), but stay away
from the pepperoni, sausage, and ground beef. Don’t be shy about
using a napkin to blot the fat that cooks out of the cheese.
